brief: A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.

requirements.evidence: Three stacked cells: piece:0,0,0;half-s (level0), piece:0,0,1;half-s (level1), piece:0,0,2;half-s (level2) with snaps between levels.
Two drawers fitted: drawer:0#0,0#cut at level 0 and drawer:1#0,0#cut at level 1 on north cut faces of half-s bases.
Level 0 drawer set to open=true, level 1 drawer remains closed, visible in look/check_build with mesh clear.

finish.summary: Three-cell vertical cabinet built from half-s bases (south halves) forming a cabinet with flat back. Two drawers occupy lower two cells; bottom drawer is open, upper drawer closed, top cell left as open-topped compartment. Caps and joint locks applied, mesh checked.

lines.label: Edge cap · female, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
